items.prompt: EXTREME CLOSE-UP INSERT SHOT of a hand pressing a button. Copy the device and the hand EXACTLY from the first picture: a chunky brushed-silver metal box with softly rounded corners (like a big metal pebble, about the size of a palm) with one large ROUND push button on top — a clear glass cap in a polished steel ring with a thin warm golden ring of light around it; the box rests on the open palm of a big fluffy WHITE PLUSH GLOVED PAW (rounded stubby plush fingers like a soft toy, one small blue oval pad). THE ACTION: the plush thumb of the same white paw comes down from above and PRESSES the round glass button firmly, the button pushed down into its ring; at the moment of the press the golden ring of light around the button flares brightly and a soft burst of warm light spills over the plush fingers and the steel. The box and the paw fill the middle of the frame, seen from slightly above and in front, very close. A sliver of the white lab-coat sleeve at the edge. Background: very dark, out of focus, deep black with a few soft round warm bokeh lights. No face in the picture.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP INSERT SHOT of the little device on top of KIMORIN's head. Copy it EXACTLY from the reference pictures: a small retro brushed-silver box with rounded corners like a tiny old television, a dark glass screen in a raised silver frame and a small speaker grille below it, mounted on top of a white plush fox head between two big pointed white fox ears with deep blue insides (the ears frame the box on the left and right edges of the picture); the top edge of brass steampunk goggles is just visible at the bottom of the frame, with a thin coiled cable running down. ON THE SCREEN: one single big bright CIRCLE outline — the Japanese quiz-show 'correct answer' maru mark ○ — drawn as a thick glowing ring of warm white-gold light, centred, filling most of the screen, pure and simple (one ring only, NOT two rings, NOT the infinity sign, no text); it glows and casts a soft golden light on the silver frame and the white fur around it. Seen straight from the front, slightly below, very close: the box fills the middle third of the frame. Background: very dark and out of focus, a few soft warm bokeh lights.

Inside the MOON TEMPLE exactly as in the first picture: a round hall of white marble columns and arches under a dome open to the starry night, a shallow round pool of glowing blue water in the floor, a thin vertical shaft of white light from the top, cool moonlit blue-white light. KIMORIN stands in the middle distance just beyond the pool, FULL BODY, facing the camera, proud and smug, feet planted, chest out; in one paw he holds out the silver push-button box toward us (copy it from the third picture), the other paw on his hip.
